_comment: English display strings for Chinese values in site/data/*.json. Keys are exact source strings. See scripts/i18n_check.py.

strings.+1.2%（更差），而且 vLLM 仍分别缓存 K 和 V: +1.2% (worse), and vLLM still caches K and V separately
strings.128 个专家里最后一个是共享专家，每个 token 用它加 7 个路由专家（论: The last of the 128 experts is a shared expert; each token uses it plus 7 routed experts (the paper states 1B active, 14B total params). During training, tokens from the same document can only pick from one common expert pool; keeping only 1/4 of the experts on their own costs only about 1 point of performance.
strings.167M–1.2B 上 NTP 困惑度、投机解码速度和零样本准确率都优于标准 M: At 167M–1.2B, better than standard MTP on NTP perplexity, speculative-decoding speed and zero-shot accuracy (no independent replication seen)
strings.3:1 混合 −3.7% / −3.4% / −3.4%，可服务 3.6 倍参数: 3:1 hybrid −3.7% / −3.4% / −3.4%, can serve 3.6× the params, iso-serving-cost prediction −4.7%; after adding MoE, QK-norm and output gate the lead shrinks to 0.3%
strings.535B 在 K、注意力输出、MoE 输出三处加 4 抽头短卷积: 535B adds a 4-tap short convolution at three places: K, attention output and MoE output
strings.535B 在每个 RMSNorm 后都加，秩 128: 535B adds it after every RMSNorm, rank 128
strings.535B 把 token 压到 3072 维再分发给 384 个专家: 535B compresses tokens to 3072 dims before dispatching them to 384 experts
strings.56 个注意力子层里一半是流式稀疏注意力，每个 query 只看开头 128 个: Half of the 56 attention sublayers are streaming sparse attention, where each query sees only the first 128 and the latest 896 tokens; the other half remain full MLA. k is counted as 12 slots, plus 256 zero-compute experts.
strings.60 层全是块稀疏注意力，M3 的前 3 层是全注意力。: All 60 layers use block-sparse attention; in M3 the first 3 layers are full attention.
strings.A.X K2 和 GigaChat 3.5，秩都是 16。GigaChat 用: A.X K2 and GigaChat 3.5, both rank 16. GigaChat uses 2σ (initial value about 1), the norm itself multiplies by (1 + w), and there are norms both before and after each sublayer.
strings.AdamH 换 MuonH 理论 1.29–1.41×，实测 1.25×: Swapping AdamH for MuonH: 1.29–1.41× in theory, 1.25× measured
strings.BPB 没有可测改善，收益只在基准分数和投机解码上体现: No measurable BPB improvement; gains show up only in benchmark scores and speculative decoding
strings.Beam：i 是第几次残差相加，系数平方和也是 1，残差流始终等于前 i 个输出: Beam: i is the index of the residual addition; the squared coefficients also sum to 1, so the residual stream always equals the sum of the first i outputs divided by √i.
strings.Command A+ 沿用 Cohere 的 LayerNorm（减均值）；同家: Command A+ keeps Cohere's LayerNorm (mean-subtracting); North Mini Code from the same vendor uses RMSNorm.
strings.DSA 的三处改动：top-k 预算里固定留开头 16 个和最近 1024 个: Three changes to DSA: the top-k budget always reserves the first 16 and the latest 1024 tokens, making KV reads more contiguous; adjacent layers reuse one index; at inference it first selects coarsely by block, then refines per token. LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse uses it too
strings.DeepSeek V4 的 K 和 V 是同一个单头向量，只有一个带权重的 no: In DeepSeek V4, K and V are the same single-head vector, with only one weighted norm.
strings.DeepSeek V4：路由专家 FP4，其余 FP8；V4.1 的块缩到 32: DeepSeek V4: routed experts in FP4, the rest in FP8; V4.1 shrinks the block to 32×32.
strings.DeepSeek-V3 的写法，用的最多；多数配合无辅助损失的偏置 b，用 σ(: The DeepSeek-V3 formulation, the most widely used; most pair it with an aux-loss-free bias b, selecting experts with σ(z) + b and computing weights from σ(z). Inkling puts the shared expert into the same normalization, ERNIE 5.5 uses several independently initialized sigmoid routers (Multi-Router), and Muse Spark first multiplies the logit by 0.177.
strings.DeepSeek-V3 的取值，跟着用的最多。: The DeepSeek-V3 value, followed by the most models.
strings.DeepSeek-V4.1 只有 4 个源层生成压缩 KV 和索引键，其余层读最: In DeepSeek-V4.1 only 4 source layers generate the compressed KV and index keys; the other layers read from the nearest source layer, while the sliding-window KV stays per-layer
strings.DeepSeek-V4.1 有 8 个索引源层，其余压缩层直接复用最近一次的 t: DeepSeek-V4.1 has 8 index source layers; the other compressed layers directly reuse the most recent top-512 selection
strings.DeepSeek、Kimi K2、gpt-oss、Mistral 用小 θ（1: DeepSeek, Kimi K2, gpt-oss and Mistral use a small θ (10K to 150K) with a large scaling factor; Mistral Large 4 extrapolates 2048× from 512 tokens to 1M.
strings.ERNIE 5.5 的 config 只给 MLA+DSA 层开了 sink，H: ERNIE 5.5's config enables the sink only on MLA+DSA layers; HCA layers are not listed.
strings.ERNIE 5.5，模型卡说它让词表分布更尖，训练开销可以忽略。: ERNIE 5.5; the model card says it sharpens the vocabulary distribution, with negligible training overhead.
strings.Engram 在这个规模上没有帮助: Engram does not help at this scale
strings.EuroLLM 团队（UTTER 项目）的多语言模型，预训练 8T token；: Multilingual model from the EuroLLM team (UTTER project), pretrained on 8T tokens; Mixtral-style architecture, 8 of 64 experts, no shared expert.
strings.GDN 原版。Qwen3.8-2.4T 的 config 写的是 swish，就: The original GDN. Qwen3.8-2.4T's config says swish, which is SiLU.
strings.GDN 和 Mamba-2 是同一个式子（A、b 每头一个）；GDN 另有一个: GDN and Mamba-2 use the same formula (one A and b per head); GDN additionally has a sigmoid write strength β_t.
strings.GLM-4.5 / 4.5-Air；之后的 GLM-4.7、GLM-5 去掉了。: GLM-4.5 / 4.5-Air; the later GLM-4.7 and GLM-5 dropped it.
strings.GLM-4.5-Air 的语言模型加视觉编码器。: GLM-4.5-Air's language model plus a vision encoder.
strings.GatedNorm：RMSNorm 后乘低秩 sigmoid 门: GatedNorm: RMSNorm followed by a low-rank sigmoid gate
strings.Granite 的 attention_multiplier，和嵌入、残差、输出: Granite's attention_multiplier, set per μP together with the embedding, residual and output multipliers.
strings.Grok 2（residual_moe）：S 是一个 32768 宽的稠密 Ge: Grok 2 (residual_moe): S is a dense GeGLU FFN of width 32768, twice as wide as each routed expert.
strings.Grok 2：c = 30，和 Gemma 2 一样把注意力 logit 限在: Grok 2: c = 30; like Gemma 2, it bounds the attention logits within ±c.
strings.HF 仓库需申请访问。取自 transformers 5.21 里 MuseSp: The HF repo requires requesting access. Taken from the defaults of MuseSparkTextConfig in transformers 5.21, whose docs state that it corresponds to the released meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B.
strings.HF 仓库需申请访问。取自公开副本 unsloth/Llama-4-Maveri: The HF repo requires requesting access. Taken from the public copy unsloth/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct; compared with the RedHatAI/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct copy, it only writes transformers defaults such as no_rope_layers, moe_layers and attn_temperature_tuning as explicit fields.
strings.HF 仓库需申请访问。取自公开副本 unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-: The HF repo requires requesting access. Taken from the public copy unsloth/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct; compared with the RedHatAI/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct copy, it only writes transformers defaults such as no_rope_layers, moe_layers and attn_temperature_tuning as explicit fields.
strings.IQuest-Q1 从第 2 层起这样算，相当于每层做一次 Post-LN，c: IQuest-Q1 computes it this way from layer 2 on, equivalent to a Post-LN in every layer, with c = 0.539 (ffn_out_scale); layer 1 is still Pre-LN, and the outputs of both sublayers pass through RMSNorm first.
strings.IQuest-Q1：s 随 query 变化，每个 query 让出的注意力权重: IQuest-Q1: s varies with the query, so each query yields a different amount of attention weight.
strings.Inkling 在 λ = 8 上再乘一个可学习标量；Gemma 4 每个专家一: Inkling multiplies λ = 8 by an additional learnable scalar; Gemma 4 has one learnable scale per expert (initial value 1); ERNIE 5.5's config gives λ = 3 and learnable, and the model card says each routed expert has its own learnable scalar.
strings.Inkling：共享专家也有路由 logit，权重和选中的路由专家一起归一化。: Inkling: the shared expert also gets a routing logit, and its weight is normalized together with the selected routed experts.
strings.Intern-S1-Pro 另带一个时间序列编码器，能读地震波这类长信号。: Intern-S1-Pro also carries a time-series encoder that can read long signals such as seismic waves.
strings.Intern-S1-Pro：混合系数初值是单位阵加小噪声，随训练学习。论文把每个: Intern-S1-Pro: the mixing coefficients start as the identity matrix plus small noise and are learned during training. The paper treats each dimension as a Fourier series over multiple frequencies, to improve length extrapolation.
strings.K2 的语言模型加上 MoonViT 视觉编码器（4 亿参数）。: K2's language model plus the MoonViT vision encoder (400M params).
strings.K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B 分 2 段；同家的 375B 不分。: K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B is split into 2 segments; the 375B from the same vendor is not.
strings.KDA 的“安全门”：log α 落在 (−5, 0)，单步最多衰减到 e⁻⁵: KDA's "safe gate": log α lies in (−5, 0), so a single step shrinks the state to no less than e⁻⁵ ≈ 0.007 of its value and never wipes the state in one step. The rank of W_a·W_b equals head_dim. Raon-1 mini's RDA uses the same decay gate, splits the write strength into a separate gate, and multiplies v by σ(β + δ) / σ(β).
strings.KDA（Kimi K3.1 Pro、Ling 3、Youtu）、Lightnin: KDA (Kimi K3.1 Pro, Ling 3, Youtu), Lightning, and the GDN of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (output_gate_type = sigmoid). GigaChat 3.5's GDN uses 2σ, with the norm multiplying by (1 + w).
strings.KRAFTON 从零训练。线性层是 RDA（Raon Delta Attenti: Trained from scratch by KRAFTON. The linear layers are RDA (Raon Delta Attention): on top of KDA, write and erase are split into two gates, with an extra σ(β + δ) write gate, decay lower bound −5 and a full-rank output gate; counted as KDA here. The residual is a 4-stream Raon-mHC whose mixing matrix is written directly as a doubly stochastic matrix using the Helmert basis, with no Sinkhorn. MLA has no positional encoding and carries a per-element sigmoid output gate; routed experts are released in MXFP8.
strings.Kimi K2 Thinking 起：路由专家是量化感知训练的 INT4（每 3: From Kimi K2 Thinking on: routed experts are quantization-aware-trained INT4 (one scale per 32 values), while attention and shared experts stay in BF16.
strings.Kimi Linear 原版，GLM-5.3-Flash 沿用；Kimi K3: The original Kimi Linear, kept by GLM-5.3-Flash; from Kimi K3 on it switched to full rank (use_full_rank_gate).
strings.Kimi Linear 的原版 KDA。: The original KDA of Kimi Linear.
strings.Klear：W_c 是 d×2 的线性层，每个 token 的两路权重加起来是: Klear: W_c is a d×2 linear layer, and each token's two weights sum to 1; the λ = 2.5 in the config is not used by the modeling code.
strings.LFM2 的门控短卷积只看最近几个 token，不需要衰减。: LFM2's gated short convolution only looks at the last few tokens, so it needs no decay.
strings.LFM2：B、C 是 x 的线性投影，没有激活函数，输出侧不再加门。: LFM2: B and C are linear projections of x with no activation function, and no further gate on the output side.
strings.LatentMoE，专家在压缩后的潜空间里计算，G 不适用。: LatentMoE: experts compute in the compressed latent space; G does not apply.
strings.Lightning Attention 与 MLA 7:1 混合，q/k 只在: Lightning Attention mixed with MLA at 7:1; q/k are normalized only in the Lightning layers.
strings.Lightning Attention 与 softmax 注意力 4:1 混合: Lightning Attention mixed with softmax attention at 4:1.
strings.Lightning Attention 与 softmax 注意力 6:1 混合: Lightning Attention mixed with softmax attention at 6:1.
strings.Lightning Attention 与 softmax 注意力 7:1 混合: Lightning Attention mixed with softmax attention at 7:1.
Lightning Attention mixed with softmax attention at 7:1; -hf is a copy converted to the transformers format.
strings.Ling 3 去掉了门的低秩分解（no_kda_lora）。: Ling 3 drops the low-rank factorization of the gate (no_kda_lora).
strings.Ling-3.0-flash 的语言模型加视觉编码器。: Ling-3.0-flash's language model plus a vision encoder.
strings.Llama 4 代码里叫 L2Norm，实际是不带权重的 RMSNorm，只用在: Called L2Norm in the Llama 4 code, but it is actually a weightless RMSNorm, applied only in the chunked layers that use RoPE.
strings.Llama 4 是 top-1，σ(z) 乘在专家的输入上而不是输出上；Koli: Llama 4 is top-1, with σ(z) multiplying the expert's input rather than its output; Kolibri first selects top-k on z + b, then takes σ.
strings.Llama 4、Beam、Inkling 只用在不加 RoPE 的全局层；Mis: Llama 4, Beam and Inkling use it only in global layers without RoPE; Mistral Large 4 uses it in every layer, with per-head learned coefficients. Grok 2 also uses it in every layer: once position n exceeds 1024, the soft-capped logit is multiplied by log n / log 1024, equivalent to n₀ = 1024, β = 1/ln 1024.
strings.LongCat 的 softmax 权重不再归一化（Σg < 1），λ 比别家都: LongCat's softmax weights are not renormalized (Σg < 1), and its λ is larger than anyone else's.
strings.LongCat 的零计算专家也参与 softmax，权重再乘 6 或 9；ZAY: LongCat's zero-compute experts also take part in the softmax, with the weights then multiplied by 6 or 9; ZAYA1's router is a small MLP that passes state across layers and selects only 1 expert per token; Grok 2 first caps the routing logits at 30 with tanh; Jamba and the Megrez2 preview also take top-k directly.
strings.MBZUAI 基础模型研究院（IFM）的 K2 系列，权重、训练数据、代码和中间: The K2 series from MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models (IFM); weights, training data, code and intermediate checkpoints are all public.
strings.Mamba-1 的写法（Jamba）：乘门之后直接进 out_proj。: Mamba-1 formulation (Jamba): after multiplying by the gate, go straight into out_proj.
strings.Mamba-1（Jamba）：Δ 每个通道一个，经秩 256 的投影算出；A 是: Mamba-1 (Jamba): one Δ per channel, computed through a rank-256 projection; A is a constant "channel × 16 state dims" matrix, so the state dims within one channel decay at different rates. Jamba adds an RMSNorm on each of Δ, B and C.
strings.Mamba-2 的写法，norm 分组算。: Mamba-2 formulation, with the norm computed per group.
strings.Marin 535B-A23B 的训练配置。初始化时 x·w≈0，门≈1，相当于: Training configuration of Marin 535B-A23B. At initialization x·w≈0 and the gate≈1, which is like starting from a model without gates.
strings.Megrez2 的预览版，同样每 3 层共用一组路由专家；路由用 softmax: The Megrez2 preview; likewise every 3 layers share one set of routed experts; routing uses softmax with no bias and no normalization, and the vocabulary also differs from the official release.
strings.MiMo-V2 的全局层不加。: MiMo-V2's global layers do not use it.
strings.MiMo-V2-Flash 的语言模型加视觉和音频编码器；V2.6 有 RL 和: MiMo-V2-Flash's language model plus vision and audio encoders; V2.6 has two post-trained versions, RL and MOPD.
strings.MiMo-V2.5-Pro 的语言模型加视觉和音频编码器；有 RL 和 MOPD: MiMo-V2.5-Pro's language model plus vision and audio encoders; there are two post-trained versions, RL and MOPD.
strings.MiniMax-M3.1-Flash：路由专家 NVFP4（每 16 个数一个缩: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash: routed experts in NVFP4 (one scale per 16 values), the remaining linear layers in MXFP8 (one scale per 32 values).
strings.MiniMax-Text-01 用 Post-LN，N = 80 层，α = 3: MiniMax-Text-01 uses Post-LN, with N = 80 layers and α = 3.56.
strings.MiniMax-Text-01 的 Lightning Attention：s_: MiniMax-Text-01's Lightning Attention: s_h is an ALiBi-style per-head slope; deeper layers decay less, and the last layer barely decays at all.
strings.MiniMax-Text-01 的语言模型加视觉编码器。: MiniMax-Text-01's language model plus a vision encoder.
strings.MoBA 块稀疏注意力：KV 每 1024 个 token 一块，每个 quer: MoBA block-sparse attention: KV is split into blocks of 1024 tokens, each query selects 8 blocks, and heads in the same GQA group share one selection; in the config the first 3 layers and the last layer do not use MoBA.
strings.MoVA（Mixture-of-Values attention）：45 个 M: MoVA (Mixture-of-Values attention): in the 45 MoE layers, attention replaces the V projection with routed value experts, 4 of 64; RMSNorm splits d_model into two groups and normalizes each separately.
strings.Moonlight-16B-A3B 的语言模型加 MoonViT 视觉编码器。: Moonlight-16B-A3B's language model plus the MoonViT vision encoder.
strings.Moonlight（k = 6）用 2.446，Kimi Linear（k =: Moonlight (k = 6) uses 2.446, and Kimi Linear (k = 8) also uses 2.446; Trinity-Large (k = 4) and Kanana-2 (k = 6) use 2.448.
strings.Muon 优化器的验证模型。: Validation model for the Muon optimizer.
strings.Muse Spark 的 QK-norm 不带权重，logit 的范围由 c =: Muse Spark's QK-norm has no weights; the logit range is set by c = 5.47.
strings.Muse Spark：m ≈ 0.177，同一个 m 也乘在路由器的 logit: Muse Spark: m ≈ 0.177, and the same m also multiplies the router's logits; Grok 2: m = 0.5, c = 50, with m multiplied directly into the output-layer weights.
strings.Muse Spark：逐通道，α² + β² = 1，τ = 0.3。: Muse Spark: per-channel, α² + β² = 1, τ = 0.3.
strings.NC AI 牵头、13 家机构组成的联合体训练，预训练 9.8T token。M: Trained by a consortium of 13 institutions led by NC AI, pretrained on 9.8T tokens. MLA alternates 40 sliding-window layers (window 512, θ = 10K) with 8 global layers (θ = 1M, with the code further dividing the frequencies by 8); there is an RMSNorm both before and after each sublayer, all multiplying by (1 + w).
strings.Nemotron 3 Nano 是 2.5，更大的三个是 5。: Nemotron 3 Nano uses 2.5; the three larger ones use 5.
strings.Nemotron 3 Nano 的语言模型加视觉和音频编码器。: Nemotron 3 Nano's language model plus vision and audio encoders.
strings.Nemotron 3 Super 的语言模型加视觉编码器；LatentMoE，G: Nemotron 3 Super's language model plus a vision encoder; LatentMoE, G does not apply.
strings.Nemotron 3 的专家只有两个矩阵。: Nemotron 3's experts have only two matrices.
strings.OLMoE 和 OLMo 2 的写法，MiniMax-M2 也这样写；MiniM: The OLMoE and OLMo 2 formulation, also used by MiniMax-M2; MiniMax-M3 switched back to per-head.
strings.PKO 的 1.2× 加速里约一半来自部分 RoPE: About half of PKO's 1.2× speedup comes from partial RoPE
strings.Phi-mini-MoE 和 Phi-tiny-MoE 沿用 Phi-3.5-M: Phi-mini-MoE and Phi-tiny-MoE keep SparseMixer-v2 from Phi-3.5-MoE and GRIN-MoE, with ε = 0.01; during training experts are selected by Gumbel sampling, and the routing gradient is then estimated with the midpoint method.
Phi-mini-MoE and Phi-tiny-MoE keep Phi-3.5-MoE's nn.LayerNorm.
strings.Phi-mini-MoE 和 Phi-tiny-MoE（attention_bi: Phi-mini-MoE and Phi-tiny-MoE (attention_bias, lm_head_bias); experts and routers have none.
strings.Qwen 系，每个 token 一个标量；AliceAI 也这样写。: The Qwen family, one scalar per token; AliceAI does the same.
strings.Qwen3-235B-A22B 的语言模型加视觉编码器。: Qwen3-235B-A22B's language model plus a vision encoder.
strings.Qwen3-30B-A3B 的语言模型加视觉编码器。: Qwen3-30B-A3B's language model plus a vision encoder.
strings.Qwen3-Next / 3.5 / 3.8 把 W_g 并进 q_proj（输: Qwen3-Next / 3.5 / 3.8 fold W_g into q_proj (output doubled, then split), while the others use a separate g_proj; Beam adds a bias with initial value 0 per head.
strings.RMSNorm(q)，在所有头拼起来的 H·d_h 维上一起算: RMSNorm(q), computed jointly over the H·d_h dims of all heads concatenated
strings.RMSNorm(q_h)，RMSNorm(k_h)，权重在各头之间共用: RMSNorm(q_h), RMSNorm(k_h), weights shared across heads
strings.Raon-1 mini：只有路由专家是 MXFP8（每 32 个数一个 2 的幂: Raon-1 mini: only the routed experts are MXFP8 (one power-of-2 scale per 32 values); attention, shared experts and the router stay in BF16.
strings.SSM 与 Transformer 混合：每 8 层里 1 层注意力、7 层 M: SSM-Transformer hybrid: of every 8 layers, 1 is attention and 7 are Mamba-1, with no positional encoding in attention; every other layer is a 2-of-16 MoE. The architecture comes from Jamba 1.5 Mini (August 2024); here we count from Jamba Mini 1.6 (February 2025). 1.6 and 1.7 require access requests, so the config could not be checked, but the weight parameter count is identical to Jamba2 Mini.
strings.Sarvam 的 safetensors 是 FP32，体积是 BF16 的两倍: Sarvam's safetensors are FP32, twice the size of BF16.
strings.Sber 的 GigaChat 3 Ultra，首发是 2025 年 11 月的: Sber's GigaChat 3 Ultra; the first release was the preview of November 2025.
strings.SiLU 门，先乘门再 norm: SiLU gate, multiply by gate then norm
strings.SmallThinker：ReLU 让大部分中间激活正好为 0，端侧推理引擎可以: SmallThinker: ReLU makes most intermediate activations exactly 0, so an on-device inference engine can skip those neurons; the model card calls this a second layer of sparsity on top of the MoE.
strings.Solar Open 2 没有建模代码。: Solar Open 2 has no modeling code.
strings.Solar Open 2 没有建模代码，权重里有逐元素的 g_proj，看不出激: Solar Open 2 has no modeling code; the weights contain a per-element g_proj, but the activation function cannot be determined.
strings.Step-3.5 只在全局层用 θ = 500 万，滑窗层是 1 万。: Step-3.5 uses θ = 5M only in global layers; sliding-window layers use 10K.
strings.Step-3.5-Flash 的语言模型加视觉编码器。: Step-3.5-Flash's language model plus a vision encoder.
strings.Trillion Labs 和 Lunit 联合体从零训练（5.5T token: Trained from scratch by a Trillion Labs and Lunit consortium (5.5T tokens); the network follows the DeepSeek-V3 design, with the vocabulary taken from GLM-4.5.
strings.V4-Flash 加视觉编码器的实验版，语言模型的配置不变。: An experimental version of V4-Flash plus a vision encoder; the language model config is unchanged.
strings.VAETKI：全局层 θ = 100 万，代码里再把频率除以 8，config: VAETKI: global layers use θ = 1M, and the code further divides the frequencies by 8, which the config does not state; sliding-window layers use θ = 10K with no scaling.
strings.Yandex 从零训练，只发布了预训练版。每 4 层是 3 层 KDA 加 1: Trained from scratch by Yandex; only the pretrained version is released. Every 4 layers are 3 KDA layers plus 1 GQA layer with an output gate; the residual stream is replaced with block AttnRes, with every 4 layers forming one block, and each layer's input is obtained by a query vector softmax-weighting the outputs of the preceding blocks and the partial sum of the current block. 10 of 512 experts, plus 1 shared expert with a sigmoid gate.
strings.ZAYA1：t_h 按 KV 头学习，注意力的温度交给模型自己定。: ZAYA1: t_h is learned per KV head, leaving the attention temperature for the model to decide.
strings.ZAYA1：两边各一组可学习的逐通道系数。: ZAYA1: one set of learnable per-channel coefficients on each side.
strings.c_q 是 MLA 压缩后的 query 潜向量，维度比 x 小得多，ERNIE: c_q is MLA's compressed query latent, with a much smaller dimension than x, so the ERNIE 5.5 model card says the gate has 75% fewer parameters. A.X K2 reads the pre- and post-normalization c_q concatenated; ERNIE 5.5 does not state the gate granularity.
strings.config 里不写外推: The config does not state extrapolation
strings.config 里写了 use_qk_norm，但 MLA 的建模代码没有用到。: The config sets use_qk_norm, but the MLA modeling code does not use it.
strings.d 是隐藏维度，r 是 q、kv 的 LoRA 秩。dots3-note 和 G: d is the hidden dimension and r is the LoRA rank of q and kv. dots3-note and GigaChat 3.5 apply it to the normalized latents, while LongCat applies it to the projected q and k; the two are equivalent.
strings.dense FFN 放到最后一层: Dense FFN moved to the last layer
strings.dense MLP 里最好（等服务成本 −1.5%），放进 2026 混合模型的: Best in the dense MLP (iso-serving-cost −1.5%), but +0.7% when put into the experts of the 2026 hybrid model
strings.g = σ(z) / Σσ(z)，分母里也有共享专家: g = σ(z) / Σσ(z), with the shared expert also in the denominator
strings.gpt-oss 把 s 拼进 logit 再做 softmax；Granite-: gpt-oss concatenates s into the logits before the softmax; Granite-SWASH directly multiplies the output by σ(lse − s); both give the same result.
strings.gpt-oss 的写法，MiniMax-M3 也用。σ 里乘 1.702 让 g: The gpt-oss formulation, also used by MiniMax-M3. Multiplying by 1.702 inside σ makes g·σ(1.702g) approximate GELU, and u gets +1.
strings.gpt-oss、Granite、SmallThinker-21B 先取 top-: gpt-oss, Granite and SmallThinker-21B take the top-k logits first and then apply softmax, giving the same result. Gemma 4's router input first passes through a weightless RMSNorm, then is multiplied by a learnable scale and d^−½. Intern-S1-Pro applies softmax over 512 experts, then takes 1 from each of 8 groups (64 per group).
strings.gpt-oss：QKV、o_proj、路由器和专家都带偏置。: gpt-oss: QKV, o_proj, router and experts all carry biases.
strings.k 按 12 个槽位计，另有 128 个零计算专家；总参数含 n-gram 嵌入: k is counted as 12 slots, plus 128 zero-compute experts; total params include the n-gram embeddings.
strings.k 按 12 个槽位计，另有 256 个零计算专家；按平均落到 FFN 专家的个: k is counted as 12 slots, plus 256 zero-compute experts; counting by the average number landing on FFN experts would be sparser (about 64).
strings.key 在学到的潜空间里分层聚类，query 每一层只给少数几个簇打分，参与注意: Keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space; at each level the query scores only a few clusters, so the number of keys attended to is independent of context length. D-LSA freezes the original model and distills only the newly added indexer (the authors did this on GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen-3.8-27B; weights not released), while N-LSA trains from scratch; the code and the SGLang implementation are open-sourced
strings.q · (1 + β·log(n / n₀))，n 是 token 的位置: q · (1 + β·log(n / n₀)), where n is the token position
strings.s = q · k_s / √d，k_s 每个 KV 头一个，value 为 0: s = q · k_s / √d, with one k_s per KV head and a value of 0
strings.sigmoid，读 query 的低秩潜向量: sigmoid, reads the query's low-rank latent
strings.softmax 注意力层的输出在进 o_proj 之前，逐头或逐元素乘一个由输入: The output of a softmax attention layer is multiplied, per head or per element, by a gate computed from the input before entering o_proj.
strings.softmax 注意力的 Q/K/V 先过因果深度卷积（线性注意力层里自带的不算: The Q/K/V of softmax attention first pass through a causal depthwise convolution (those built into linear-attention layers are not counted); Inkling also adds one on the output of each of the two sublayers
strings.softplus 没有上界，门可以大于 1，既能关掉也能放大。Laguna XS: softplus has no upper bound, so the gate can exceed 1 and can both shut off and amplify. Laguna XS.2 and S 2.1 are per-head, M.1 is per-element; K2-Horizon-MoVA is per-element, with softplus β = ln 2, so the gate is exactly 1 when x·W_g = 0.
strings.token 嵌入进第一层之前有没有额外处理。: Whether the token embeddings get extra processing before entering the first layer.
strings.x / rms(x) ⊙ (1 + w)，w 初值 0: x / rms(x) ⊙ (1 + w), w initialized to 0
strings.x / rms(x) ⊙ w，w 初值 1: x / rms(x) ⊙ w, w initialized to 1
strings.xAI 2024 年训练和使用的模型，2025 年 8 月开放权重；没有公布参数: A model xAI trained and used in 2024, with weights opened in August 2025; the parameter count was not published, so it is computed here from the config (active includes embeddings). Each layer has a 32768-wide dense FFN in parallel with 2-of-8 experts. Attention logits first pass through a tanh soft cap with limit 30, then are multiplied by log n / log 1024 once the position exceeds 1024; routing logits are also capped at 30.
strings.y = λ · Σ_{i∈top-k} g_i · E_i(x) + 共享专家: y = λ · Σ_{i∈top-k} g_i · E_i(x) + shared expert
strings.β·tanh(g/β)·σ(g) 代替 SiLU，gate 和 up 两路都用: β·tanh(g/β)·σ(g) replaces SiLU, with tanh soft capping on both the gate and up branches
strings.μP：除以宽度倍数: μP: divide by the width multiplier
strings.−0.42% / −0.41% / −0.33%，8 个种子全部改善，并消除第一: −0.42% / −0.41% / −0.33%, improved on all 8 seeds, and removes the gradient spikes caused by the first-layer dense FFN
strings.−2.1% / −0.8% / −1.0%；混合模型的全局层上 −0.4%，最终: −2.1% / −0.8% / −1.0%; −0.4% on the global layers of the hybrid model, kept in the final architecture
strings.−2.2% → −1.8%，比大多数结构改动保得住: −2.2% → −1.8%, holds up better than most architecture changes
strings.下一层注意力读的是还没加路由专家输出的残差，MoE 的 all-to-all 合: The next layer's attention reads the residual before the routed-expert output is added, so the MoE all-to-all combine can run concurrently with it; existing models can be converted to this connection via self-distillation
strings.不另加 MTP 模块，让主干自己的最后一层预测后面几个 token，多步损失直接: No separate MTP module: the backbone's own last layer predicts the next several tokens, so the multi-step loss acts directly on the parameters that generate the next token; at inference the model serves as its own draft model
strings.不带权重，k 乘每头温度: weightless, k multiplied by a per-head temperature
strings.不带权重，q 乘常数: weightless, q multiplied by a constant
strings.专家 FFN 的门控激活: Gated activation of the expert FFN
strings.专家里 gate 支路用什么非线性，以及要不要截掉过大的值。: Which nonlinearity the gate branch in the experts uses, and whether overly large values are clipped.
strings.中国电信人工智能研究院（TeleAI）的星辰模型，在昇腾 910C 上训练；In: The Xingchen model from China Telecom's Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), trained on Ascend 910C; Intent is an intent-recognition model with the same architecture.
strings.主仓库发布的权重格式，不少家另外发 BF16 或 FP8 版本。: The weight format released in the main repo; many vendors also release BF16 or FP8 versions separately.
strings.乘常数再软截断: multiply by a constant, then soft cap
strings.以 LongCat-Flash-Lite 为主干，图像和音频都离散成 token: Built on LongCat-Flash-Lite; images and audio are both discretized into tokens and share one vocabulary with text.
strings.优化器只能从技术报告里看，这里只列核对过的: The optimizer can only be seen from the technical report; only verified ones are listed here
strings.位置信息交给滑窗层、线性层或 Mamba 层，全局层不用外推。: Positional information is left to the sliding-window, linear or Mamba layers; the global layers need no extrapolation.
strings.先把少量物理 query 头线性混成更多\"虚拟头\"，输出再做一次低秩的跨头混: First linearly mix a small number of physical query heads into more "virtual heads", then apply a low-rank cross-head mixing to the output; both steps are linear and fold into the Q and output projections at inference, so it still runs as ordinary GQA
strings.全局层 RoPE 的基频 θ，以及发布的 config 里写的长上下文外推方法。: The base frequency θ of the global layers' RoPE, and the long-context extrapolation method stated in the released config. The larger θ is, the slower the low-frequency dimensions rotate.
strings.全局层不加位置编码，位置信息交给滑窗、分块或线性层（Llama 4 叫 iRoP: Global layers have no positional encoding; positional information is left to sliding-window, chunked or linear layers (called iRoPE in Llama 4)
strings.共享专家怎么并入: How the shared expert is merged in
strings.共享专家是一个 16384 宽的 MLP，这里按路由专家的宽度折成 4 个。模型: The shared expert is a single MLP of width 16384, counted here as 4 experts at the routed experts' width. The model card says an additive bias was used for load balancing during training, but the released weights do not contain this bias.
strings.几个独立初始化的 sigmoid 路由器一起打分选专家，再按各路由器给这个专家的: Several independently initialized sigmoid routers score and select experts jointly, and each expert's latent-space input is then mixed according to the relative scores the routers gave it
strings.分段的可学习温度代替 softmax: A piecewise learnable temperature replaces softmax
strings.初始化时和乘 w 一样，但对 w 做权重衰减时拉向的是“不缩放”。Gemma 1: Identical to multiplying by w at initialization, but weight decay on w pulls toward "no scaling". Gemma 1–3 also use this form, and Gemma 4 switched back to multiplying by w. Muse Spark's norm after a sublayer is weightless, or multiplies by (1 + w) first and then normalizes. VAETKI and AliceAI also multiply by (1 + w).
strings.参考模型 −2.4% / −2.2% / −1.3% 但服务成本抵消收益；在 2: Reference model −2.4% / −2.2% / −1.3%, but serving cost offsets the gain; on the 2026 hybrid model it is the largest gain of the first round (−1.8%)
strings.另有 196B Engram；激活取 decode 的 16B（prefill: Plus a 196B Engram; active params use the decode figure of 16B (prefill 8B).
strings.只改 MTP 的损失：去掉梯度里的噪声项，只留 KL 自蒸馏: Changes only the MTP loss: drops the noise term in the gradient and keeps only KL self-distillation
strings.只放出语言模型（config 写明 language_model_only），权: Only the language model is released (the config states language_model_only); the weights contain neither the vision encoder nor the MTP layer of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.
strings.只有路由专家是 4 位（每 32 个数一个缩放），注意力、共享专家和路由器保持高: Only the routed experts are 4-bit (one scale per 32 values); attention, shared experts and the router stay in high precision. The Kimi K3.1 Pro model card states it is quantization-aware training (weights MXFP4, activations MXFP8).
strings.可学习版本的收益到 d=768 消失: The gain of the learnable version vanishes at d=768
strings.可学习的 sink key，所有注意力层: learnable sink key, all attention layers
strings.各宽度约 −1%；去掉 RMSNorm 的可学习缩放后收益消失: About −1% at every width; the gain vanishes once RMSNorm's learnable scale is removed
strings.同参数下和 MHA 持平；KV 缩小后可服务更大的模型，等服务成本预测 −4.1: On par with MHA at equal params; the smaller KV lets a larger model be served, iso-serving-cost prediction −4.1%
strings.和 VAETKI 同一套写法的小模型，预训练 3.62T token；λ = 1: A smaller model with the same design as VAETKI, pretrained on 3.62T tokens; λ = 1, and only layer 1 is dense.
strings.和 VAETKI 同一套写法，64 个专家选 5 个，预训练 1.86T tok: Same design as VAETKI, 5 of 64 experts, pretrained on 1.86T tokens.
strings.和完整 RoPE 相差 1% 以内，BPB 分不出差别: Within 1% of full RoPE; BPB shows no difference
strings.和路由专家一起打分: scored together with the routed experts
strings.图像理解和生成共用 MingTok 的连续视觉 token；config 里留着: Image understanding and generation share MingTok's continuous visual tokens; the config keeps an audio_config, but the weights contain no audio part.
strings.图文多模态，激活 52B 含嵌入（不含为 49B）。72 层都是带 DSA 索引: Text + image multimodal; active 52B including embeddings (49B excluding). All 72 layers are MLA with a DSA indexer; every 4th layer has no RoPE, and the 9 such layers from layer 39 on read the KV of layer 35 directly. RoPE frequencies are learnable (LeRoPE); the weights include a DSpark speculative-decoding draft head.
strings.在 K3 上继续后训练，并把 24 个门控 MLA 全局层换成门控 DSA（加: Post-trained further from K3, with the 24 gated MLA global layers replaced by gated DSA (adding a top-2048 indexer); the MoE config is unchanged.
strings.在 LongCat-Flash-Lite 上把 MLA 换成 LSA（LongC: On top of LongCat-Flash-Lite, MLA is replaced with LSA (LongCat Sparse Attention); k is counted as 12 slots, plus 128 zero-compute experts, and total params include the n-gram embeddings.
strings.在 V3.1-Terminus 的 MLA 上加了 DSA 索引器。: A DSA indexer is added to V3.1-Terminus's MLA.
strings.在压缩的潜空间里算注意力，并对 Q、K 做卷积混合；ZAYA1 用的是分组版 C: Attention is computed in the compressed latent space, with convolutional mixing on Q and K; ZAYA1 uses the grouped version, CCGQA
strings.在已有卷积的候选模型上没有帮助（Canon-A +0.78%，Canon-C +: No help on candidate models that already have convolutions (Canon-A +0.78%, Canon-C +0.07%)
strings.块 AttnRes（块大小 4）实测 1.06–1.12×，吞吐降 4–7%: Block AttnRes (block size 4) measured 1.06–1.12×, with throughput down 4–7%
strings.多数是 128×128 的块，每块一个缩放；DeepSeek 和 ERNIE 5: Most use 128×128 blocks with one scale per block; DeepSeek's and ERNIE 5.5's scales are powers of 2 (ue8m0); Mistral Small 4 uses one scale per tensor.
strings.多数直接用大基频训到目标长度，Qwen 系是 1e6–1e7，dots3-not: Most train directly to the target length with a large base frequency: 1e6–1e7 for the Qwen family, up to 8e7 for dots3-note; some model cards suggest adding YaRN yourself at inference.
strings.子层输入 = Σ_j softmax_j(w · RMSNorm(b_j)) ·: Sublayer input = Σ_j softmax_j(w · RMSNorm(b_j)) · b_j, where b_j are the embedding, the sum of outputs of each preceding block, and the partial sum of the current block
strings.子层输出 f(h) 怎么加回残差流。: How the sublayer output f(h) is added back to the residual stream.
strings.对 K、V 做 4 抽头因果卷积：−1.0% / −0.7% / −0.7%，最: A 4-tap causal convolution on K and V: −1.0% / −0.7% / −0.7%, kept in the final architecture on the global layers
strings.对 dense 参考模型是最好的单项（等服务成本 −5.7%），但加到已有细粒度: The best single item for the dense reference model (iso-serving-cost −5.7%), but within noise when added to a model that already has a fine-grained MoE
strings.层排布是 1 层全局、21 组（1 层全局 + 3 层滑窗）、再 3 层全局，窗: Layer layout: 1 global layer, 21 groups (1 global + 3 sliding-window layers), then 3 more global layers, with a window of 4096. The sink's logit is not a constant but the dot product of the query with one learnable sink key per KV head, with a value of 0. From layer 2 on, the residual stream is replaced by its RMSNorm before attention, the attention output also passes through RMSNorm before being added, and the FFN output is multiplied by 0.539. MTP weights live in a separate mtp/ directory, and at inference the single layer is applied recurrently 8 times.
strings.层数、宽度和每个专家的大小都和 Qwen3-235B-A22B 相同，专家从 1: Layer count, width and per-expert size are the same as Qwen3-235B-A22B, with experts expanded from 128 to 512; routing first applies softmax over all experts, then selects 1 from each of 8 groups (64 per group) so that the GPUs in expert parallelism are load-balanced. The positional encoding is FoPE, and it also carries a time-series encoder. Total params are recorded as 1T per the technical report, about 0.92T by weight count.
strings.层间用 FarSkip-Collective 连接：下一层注意力读的是不含路由专: Layers are connected with FarSkip-Collective: the next layer's attention reads the residual without the routed-expert output, so the experts' all-to-all communication can overlap with it.
strings.嵌入、注意力、残差和输出 logit 按宽度乘固定系数，小模型上调好的超参数可以: Embeddings, attention, residual and output logits are multiplied by fixed width-dependent coefficients, so hyperparameters tuned on small models transfer directly to large ones; only these multipliers are visible in the config
strings.已下架；第三方 GGUF 的文件头显示 MoE 配置与 3.1 相同: Taken down; the header of a third-party GGUF shows the same MoE config as 3.1
strings.已采用，称带来又一次加速；535B 的注意力输出减去自身 V 方向的分量: Adopted, reported to give another speedup; in 535B the attention output has its own V-direction component subtracted
strings.常规初始化下 3 个种子 2 个发散；嵌入乘 √d 后仍 +3.1%: With standard initialization 2 of 3 seeds diverge; still +3.1% after multiplying embeddings by √d
strings.式子取自 DeepSeek V4 的代码，混合矩阵用 Sinkhorn 迭代归一: The formula is taken from DeepSeek V4's code, with the mixing matrix normalized by Sinkhorn iteration. Raon-1 mini's Raon-mHC does not iterate: it writes the mixing matrix directly as a doubly stochastic matrix using the Helmert basis, and the read-in has no ε.
strings.式子取自 DeepSeek V4，其余按各自 config 的上限 c；括号里是: The formula is taken from DeepSeek V4; the others use the cap c from their own configs; parentheses mean clamping only in some layers. Maple-Preview's c = 7 is written in its modeling code.
strings.快手 Klear 团队。共享专家和路由专家的输出按输入算出的两个 softmax: Kuaishou's Klear team. The shared-expert and routed-expert outputs are summed with two softmax coefficients computed from the input.
strings.总参数和激活参数都按模型卡，不含嵌入。: Total and active params follow the model card, excluding embeddings.
strings.把 SiLU 里线性增长的 g 换成 tanh 软截断，两条支路都有上限。Kim: Replaces the linearly growing g in SiLU with a tanh soft cap, so both branches are bounded. Kimi K3 used it first; the ERNIE 5.5 model card says it makes the scale of expert outputs more stable.
strings.把 x 切成 n 段，每段 x_j / rms(x_j)，再乘 w: Split x into n segments, take x_j / rms(x_j) for each, then multiply by w
strings.按位置的 log 放大 query，长上下文里注意力不被摊平。Llama 4、B: Scales the query by the log of the position so attention does not flatten out in long contexts. Llama 4, Beam and Inkling use it only in global layers without RoPE, Mistral Large 4 uses it in every layer with per-head learned coefficients; Step-5 applies it to the sparse indexer's scoring
strings.按频率分段插值，并把 logit 乘 0.1·ln(s) + 1: Per-frequency-band interpolation, with the logit multiplied by 0.1·ln(s) + 1
strings.收录的模型都把 dense 层放在最前面: All listed models put the dense layers first
strings.改用 softmax + 均衡损失、去掉共享专家、换 SMEBU 或 sqrt-: Switching to softmax + balance loss, removing the shared expert, or changing to SMEBU or sqrt-softplus all show no measurable difference
strings.文本、图像、视频、音频多模态。13 个 DSA 层和 33 个滑窗层都是 MLA: Text, image, video and audio multimodal. The 13 DSA layers and 33 sliding-window layers are all MLA, with the sliding-window layers using a separate set of dimensions (64 heads, latent dim 1024); MTP is one shared layer.
strings.文本、图像、视频、音频多模态，编码器不写在 config.json 里，模态按模: Text, image, video and audio multimodal; the encoders are not listed in config.json, and modalities are annotated per the model card; the language model is the same as LongCat-Flash, with k counted as 12 slots, plus 256 zero-compute experts.
strings.文本、图像、音频多模态。全局层不用 RoPE，而用学到的相对位置 logit（只: Text, image and audio multimodal. Global layers use no RoPE, but a learned relative-position logit (covering only distances within 1024 tokens).
strings.文本、图像、音频多模态；不同模态的 token 各用一个路由门。: Text, image and audio multimodal; tokens of each modality use their own routing gate.
strings.文本、图像、音频多模态；文本、图像、音频 token 各用一个路由门（Multi: Text, image and audio multimodal; text, image and audio tokens each use their own routing gate (MultiRouter).
strings.无权重，k 乘每头温度: weightless, k multiplied by a per-head temperature
strings.无问芯穹的端侧模型：每 3 层共用一组路由专家（共 10 组），各层的路由器和共: On-device model from Infinigence AI: every 3 layers share one set of routed experts (10 sets in total), while each layer's router and shared expert are independent, so storage is only 7.5B, or about 21B when expanded per layer. The router reads the previous layer's FFN input, so experts can be prefetched at inference.
strings.日本国立情报学研究所（NII）；Mixtral 式 8 选 2，模型卡引用 Dr: Japan's National Institute of Informatics (NII); Mixtral-style 2-of-8, and the model card cites Drop-Upcycling.
strings.最后一层的隐状态怎么变成词表上的分布。: How the last layer's hidden state becomes a distribution over the vocabulary.
strings.有共享专家时，它的输出和路由专家的加权和怎么合起来。: When there is a shared expert, how its output is combined with the weighted sum of the routed experts.
strings.架构就是 2024 年 12 月的 DeepSeek-V3，这里从 2025 年: The architecture is exactly DeepSeek-V3 of December 2024; here we count from the R1 uploaded in January 2025.
strings.架构就是 2024 年 9 月的 OLMoE-1B-7B-0924，这里从 20: The architecture is exactly OLMoE-1B-7B-0924 of September 2024; here we count from the 0125 version of January 2025. Training data, code and intermediate checkpoints are all public.
strings.标准做法是 logit 乘 1/√d（d 是每个头的维度）；有的模型另加或换成别: The standard practice is to multiply the logit by 1/√d (d is the per-head dimension); some models add or substitute other coefficients.
strings.模型卡说是早期的后训练检查点。: The model card says it is an early post-training checkpoint.
strings.残差流不再逐层相加，每个子层用自己的查询向量 w 从前面各块里取输入。Kimi: The residual stream no longer accumulates layer by layer; each sublayer takes its input from the preceding blocks using its own query vector w. Kimi K3 forms one block per 12 layers, AliceAI one per 4 layers.
strings.残差相加按层深缩放：子层输出乘 1/√i，残差乘 √((i−1)/i)。: Residual addition scaled by layer depth: the sublayer output is multiplied by 1/√i and the residual by √((i−1)/i).
strings.每 2–4 层跑一次索引器，128K 时服务量 1.33–1.37 倍；4 层共: The indexer runs once every 2–4 layers, giving 1.33–1.37× serving throughput at 128K; with 4 layers sharing, one seed collapsed, but it was fine after adding IndexCache's cross-layer distillation loss
strings.每个 RMSNorm 后乘一个秩 16、初值约为 1 的 2·sigmoid 门: After each RMSNorm, multiply by a rank-16 2·sigmoid gate with initial value around 1; the model card says it is meant to replace the sinks that form spontaneously in attention and the residual.
strings.每个头只有一个标量门，W_g 只有 d×H。dots3-note 的滑窗层也加了: Each head has only a single scalar gate, so W_g is only d×H. dots3-note's sliding-window layers also carry the gate.
strings.每个头多一个可学习的 logit s，参与 softmax 归一化但不对应任何: Each head has one extra learnable logit s that takes part in the softmax normalization but corresponds to no value, so attention can hand part of its weight to it and attend a little less.
strings.每个维度的 cos、sin 换成各频率 cos、sin 的可学习线性组合，每个: Each dimension's cos and sin are replaced by a learnable linear combination of the cos and sin of all frequencies, one set per KV head
strings.每个通道、每个状态维，Δ 低秩: per channel and per state dim, Δ low-rank
strings.每个通道，低秩，无下界: per channel, low-rank, no lower bound
strings.每层先把残差流归一化: Normalize the residual stream at the start of each layer
strings.比 GLM-5.1 多了索引复用（IndexShare）：78 层里有 57 层: Compared with GLM-5.1 it adds index reuse (IndexShare): 57 of the 78 layers reuse the DSA top-k selection of earlier layers.
strings.没有公开建模代码，结构按 config 和权重名推断。: No public modeling code; the architecture is inferred from the config and weight names.
strings.没有质量收益，也替代不了 QK-norm 的可学习缩放: No quality gain, and it cannot replace QK-norm's learnable scale
strings.没有质量收益，学习率 8e-3 时会炸: No quality gain, and it blows up at a learning rate of 8e-3
strings.注意力和输出层带: attention and output layer have it
strings.混合模型的全局层去掉位置编码没问题，加回部分 RoPE 反而 +0.2%；所有层: Removing positional encoding from the global layers of the hybrid model is fine, and adding partial RoPE back is actually +0.2%; removing it from all layers makes training collapse
strings.用 SlimMoE 从 Phi-3.5-MoE 剪枝蒸馏而来，专家裁到 448: Pruned and distilled from Phi-3.5-MoE with SlimMoE, with experts trimmed to width 448 and the numbers of query and KV heads also halved. The config sets sliding_window = 2047, and the model card says it uses FlashAttention by default, a path that applies a 2047 window in every layer.
strings.用 SlimMoE 从 Phi-3.5-MoE（41.9B / 6.6B）多阶段: Pruned and distilled in multiple stages from Phi-3.5-MoE (41.9B / 6.6B) with SlimMoE; attention is unchanged and experts are trimmed from width 6400 to 960. The config sets sliding_window = 2047, and the model card says it uses FlashAttention by default, a path that applies a 2047 window in every layer.
strings.由 Gravity-16B-A3B-Base 按 LLaMA-Pro 的块扩展从: Expanded from 28 to 52 layers from Gravity-16B-A3B-Base using LLaMA-Pro block expansion, then pretrained further.
strings.目前只放出预训练结束时的 Base。37 层 HCA（每 128 个 token: Only the Base at the end of pretraining has been released so far. 37 HCA layers (one KV entry stored per 128 tokens) + 6 MLA+DSA layers; the output gate is computed from the query's low-rank latent, routing uses multiple routers (Multi-Router Latent MoE), and MTP directly uses the backbone's last layer (ECHO).
strings.第 1 个专家取 argmax，权重是 logit 与最大值相差不到 2ε 的那: The 1st expert is the argmax, with weights given by the softmax over the experts whose logits are within 2ε of the maximum; remove it, then pick the 2nd the same way
strings.第三轮里小模型上最大的增益：−4.1% / −2.5% / −1.4%，宽度每升: The largest gain on small models in the third round: −4.1% / −2.5% / −1.4%, about 60% remaining with each step up in width; the servable model is 14% smaller
strings.第二轮里唯一保住收益的改动（d=512 −0.71%，d=768 −0.49%）: The only change in the second round whose gain held up (d=512 −0.71%, d=768 −0.49%), and it also removed gradient spikes
strings.等价于输出乘一个门 o · σ(lse − s)，lse 是这一行 logit: Equivalent to multiplying the output by a gate o · σ(lse − s), where lse is the log-sum-exp of this row of logits
strings.算注意力之前先把 Q、K 归一化，控制 logit 的大小。MLA 对低秩潜向量: Normalize Q and K before computing attention to control the logit magnitude. MLA's norm on the low-rank latents is not counted.
strings.线性层带不带偏置。: Whether the linear layers carry biases.
strings.线性注意力和 SSM 的状态每一步先乘一个衰减 α_t ∈ (0, 1) 再写入: At each step, the state of linear attention and SSMs is first multiplied by a decay α_t ∈ (0, 1) before new content is written in; α determines how fast it forgets.
strings.线性注意力层的输出进 o_proj 之前也乘一个由 x 算出的门，并配一个 no: The output of a linear-attention layer is also multiplied by a gate computed from x before o_proj, together with a norm; the gate's activation, its rank, and the order of gate and norm differ between vendors.
strings.翻译专用模型；Hy-Memory 是同一架构的记忆写入模型。: A translation-specific model; Hy-Memory is a memory-writing model of the same architecture.
strings.词表从 LFM2 的 65536 扩到 128000，其余结构不变。: The vocabulary is expanded from LFM2's 65536 to 128000; the rest of the architecture is unchanged.
strings.读入 σ(·) + ε，写回 2σ(·)，4 路之间用双随机矩阵混合: Read-in σ(·) + ε, write-back 2σ(·), with the 4 streams mixed by a doubly stochastic matrix
strings.读入用 σ 混合，写回 2σ / n: Read-in mixed with σ, write-back 2σ / n
strings.质量和 HC 相同、高学习率更稳，但可服务的激活参数从 9.1B 降到 7.4B: Same quality as HC and more stable at high learning rates, but servable active params drop from 9.1B to 7.4B
strings.质量无可测损失；16–24K 上下文时索引器比省下的注意力还贵，长上下文才划算: No measurable quality loss; at 16–24K context the indexer costs more than the attention it saves, so it only pays off at long context
strings.质量无可测损失；256K 时可服务的模型大 1.05 倍: No measurable quality loss; at 256K the servable model is 1.05× larger
strings.路由专家的加权和再乘一个常数 λ（routed_scaling_factor）。: The weighted sum of the routed experts is multiplied by a constant λ (routed_scaling_factor). After normalization Σg = 1, and λ sets the weight of the routed experts relative to the residual stream and the shared expert.
strings.路由器是一个小 MLP，路由状态逐层往下传（EDA）。: The router is a small MLP, and the routing state is passed down layer by layer (EDA).
strings.路由器给每个专家打分、选出 top-k，再算专家输出的权重 g。打分函数和要不要: The router scores every expert, selects the top-k, then computes the weights g of the expert outputs. The scoring function and whether to renormalize the top-k weights are combined differently by each vendor.
strings.输出头旁加一个指向前文的复制头，代码见 modded-nanogpt PR 37: Adds a copy head that points to earlier context next to the output head; code in modded-nanogpt PR 379
strings.输出层是否直接用嵌入矩阵的转置。绑定省下一份 V×d 的参数，在小模型里占比更大: Whether the output layer directly uses the transpose of the embedding matrix. Tying saves one V×d block of parameters, a larger share in small models.
strings.输出门从 MLA 的 query 潜向量算，不读隐状态；ERNIE 5.5 的模: The output gate is computed from MLA's query latent rather than the hidden state; the ERNIE 5.5 model card claims 75% fewer gate parameters and even better results
strings.输出门用 softplus；滑窗层 64 个 Q 头，全局层 48 个。: The output gate uses softplus; sliding-window layers have 64 Q heads, global layers 48.
strings.输出门用 softplus；滑窗层 72 个 Q 头，全局层 48 个。: The output gate uses softplus; sliding-window layers have 72 Q heads, global layers 48.
strings.这一行的检查点能处理哪些输入。同一个语言模型加上视觉或音频编码器的版本算另一个架: Which inputs this row's checkpoint can handle. A version of the same language model with a vision or audio encoder counts as a different architecture and gets its own row.
strings.这几个模型都是 k = 8，λ 数值上接近 √k ≈ 2.828。: These models all have k = 8, with λ numerically close to √k ≈ 2.828.
strings.逐通道逐状态，Δ 低秩: per channel and per state, Δ low-rank
strings.阿里国际的多语言模型，由 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 切分 FFN 子矩阵再: A multilingual model from Alibaba International, converted into an MoE from Qwen3-0.6B-Base by splitting FFN submatrices and applying Drop-Upcycling.
strings.面向端侧的推理模型。模型卡说权重是三值的（端侧检查点 5.31 GB），这个仓库: An on-device reasoning model. The model card says the weights are ternary (on-device checkpoint 5.31 GB); this repo stores BF16. 3 sliding-window layers (window 512, RoPE applied to only half the dims) alternate with 1 global layer without positional encoding; the experts' SwiGLU clamps the gate branch to at most 7 and the up branch to ±7.
strings.面向端侧：路由器读的是注意力之前的层输入，推理引擎可以一边算注意力一边从存储预取: On-device oriented: the router reads the layer input before attention, so the inference engine can prefetch experts from storage while computing attention.

On-device oriented: the router reads the layer input before attention, so the inference engine can prefetch experts from storage while computing attention. Global layers have no RoPE; the other 3/4 are sliding-window layers with a 4096 window.
strings.频率 θ_i 全部除以 s，相当于把位置 m 换成 m / s: All frequencies θ_i are divided by s, equivalent to replacing position m with m / s
strings.高频不动，低频按倍数缩，中间平滑过渡: High frequencies are left alone, low frequencies are scaled by the factor, with a smooth transition in between
